source: Hand-written seed (2026-10-12) covering the shipped cell types, their ancestors, and the GO and Uberon ids the studies use. Names and definitions paraphrase the Cell Ontology (CC BY 4.0), Gene Ontology (CC BY 4.0) and Uberon (CC BY 3.0) from memory; tools/import_cl.py replaces this file from raw/cl/cl-basic.json once Friend downloads it, and every id here must be confirmed then.

CL:0000000.name: cell
CL:0000000.def: A material entity of anatomical origin (part of or deriving from an organism) that has as its parts a maximally connected cell compartment surrounded by a plasma membrane.

CL:0000003.name: native cell
CL:0000003.def: A cell that is found in a natural setting, which includes multicellular organism cells 'in vivo' (i.e. part of an organism), and unicellular organisms 'in environment'.

CL:0000255.name: eukaryotic cell
CL:0000255.def: A cell with a nucleus and membrane-bound organelles.

CL:0000548.name: animal cell
CL:0000548.def: A native cell that is part of some Metazoa.

CL:0002371.name: somatic cell
CL:0002371.def: A cell of an organism that is not a germ cell.

CL:0000066.name: epithelial cell
CL:0000066.def: A cell that is usually found in a two-dimensional sheet with a free surface; epithelial cells are tightly bound to each other.

CL:0002320.name: connective tissue cell
CL:0002320.def: A cell of the supporting or framework tissue of the body, arising chiefly from the embryonic mesoderm.

CL:0000187.name: muscle cell
CL:0000187.def: A mature contractile cell, commonly known as a myocyte, that contains actin and myosin filaments.

CL:0002319.name: neural cell
CL:0002319.def: A cell that is part of the nervous system.

CL:0000988.name: hematopoietic cell
CL:0000988.def: A cell of a hematopoietic lineage.

CL:0000737.name: striated muscle cell
CL:0000737.def: Muscle cell which has as its contractile apparatus myofibrils showing cross-striations.

CL:0000188.name: cell of skeletal muscle
CL:0000188.def: A muscle cell that is part of skeletal muscle.

CL:0008002.name: skeletal muscle fiber
CL:0008002.def: A skeletal muscle cell that is a multinucleate syncytium formed by the fusion of myoblasts; the contractile unit of skeletal muscle.

CL:0000594.name: skeletal muscle satellite cell
CL:0000594.def: An elongated, spindle-shaped, quiescent stem cell lying between the basal lamina and the sarcolemma of a skeletal muscle fiber; the source of new muscle nuclei in growth and repair.

CL:0000192.name: smooth muscle cell
CL:0000192.def: A non-striated, elongated, spindle-shaped muscle cell found in the walls of hollow organs and vessels.

CL:0000359.name: vascular associated smooth muscle cell
CL:0000359.def: A smooth muscle cell associated with the vasculature; the contractile cell of the tunica media.

CL:0000115.name: endothelial cell
CL:0000115.def: An endothelial cell comprises the outermost layer or lining of anatomical structures and can be squamous or cuboidal; it lines blood and lymphatic vessels.

CL:0000057.name: fibroblast
CL:0000057.def: A connective tissue cell which secretes an extracellular matrix rich in collagen and other macromolecules; flattened and irregular in outline with branching processes.

CL:0000136.name: fat cell
CL:0000136.def: A fat-storing cell found mostly in the abdominal cavity and subcutaneous tissue; fat is usually stored in a single large droplet.

CL:0001035.name: bone cell
CL:0001035.def: A connective tissue cell found in bone.

CL:0000062.name: osteoblast
CL:0000062.def: A bone-forming cell which secretes an extracellular matrix; hydroxyapatite crystals are then deposited into the matrix to form bone.

CL:0000137.name: osteocyte
CL:0000137.def: A mature osteoblast that has become embedded in the bone matrix, occupying a lacuna and communicating through canaliculi.

CL:0000092.name: osteoclast
CL:0000092.def: A specialized multinuclear phagocyte that resorbs bone; derived from monocyte precursors.

CL:0000540.name: neuron
CL:0000540.def: The basic cellular unit of nervous tissue; each neuron consists of a body, an axon, and dendrites.

CL:0000100.name: motor neuron
CL:0000100.def: An efferent neuron that passes from the central nervous system or a ganglion toward or to a muscle and conducts an impulse that causes movement.

CL:0000125.name: glial cell
CL:0000125.def: A non-neuronal cell of the nervous system; glial cells provide support and nutrition, maintain homeostasis, form myelin and participate in signal transmission.

CL:0002573.name: Schwann cell
CL:0002573.def: A glial cell that ensheathes axons of neurons in the peripheral nervous system and is necessary for their maintenance and function.

CL:0000232.name: erythrocyte
CL:0000232.def: A red blood cell; in mammals an anucleate, biconcave disc carrying haemoglobin.

unconfirmed.FMA:9623: muscle fascicle (FMA id written from memory)
